description: Lists the commodities tracked in GATS trade flows (matched to Census data by HS chapter) with display labels. Use to discover valid `commodity` slugs before calling get_trade_flows or compare_contracts_vs_shipments. Read-only; no API key. The list is the configured catalog — individual commodities can still be withheld in get_trade_flows when their source data fails sanity checks.
name: list_gats_commodities
